1//! PdfCraft patch (70): an isolated transparency group that blends in `DeviceCMYK`.
2//!
3//! ISO 32000-2 §11.3.4: a group's elements blend in the group's colour space, and the
4//! components of a subtractive space are complemented before the blend function and
5//! complemented back after it. The renderer composites in RGB, which gives other colours
6//! wherever a blend mode meets CMYK artwork: `0 1 0 0 k` (magenta) under `0 0 0 1 k` (black)
7//! with `/BM /Difference` is green when blended in CMYK (`|(1,0,1,1) − (1,1,1,0)|`
8//! complemented back is `1 0 1 0`) and magenta when blended in RGB.
9//!
10//! An *isolated* group starts from a transparent backdrop of its own (§11.4.7), so its
11//! interior can be computed apart from the page and handed back as finished pixels. A device
12//! that can blend in CMYK takes such a group through [`Device::draw_isolated_cmyk_group`] and
13//! interprets it with [`CmykGroup::interpret`] as often as it needs; every other device, and a
14//! device that declines, gets the group's contents as before.
15
16use crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::InterpreterSettings;
17use crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::context::{Context, InterpreterCache};
18use crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::device::Device;
19use crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::interpret::state::{ClipType, State};
20use crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::x_object::{FormXObject, interpret_form_contents};
21use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::dict::keys::{CS, GROUP};
22use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::{Dict, Name};
23use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::page::Resources;
24use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::xref::XRef;
25use kurbo::{Affine, Rect, Shape};
26use std::ops::Deref;
27
28/// An isolated, non-knockout transparency group whose blending colour space is `DeviceCMYK`,
29/// captured where it is painted (PdfCraft patch (70); see the module documentation).
30pub struct CmykGroup<'a, 'b> {
31    form: &'b FormXObject<'a>,
32    resources: &'b Resources<'a>,
33    /// The graphics state the group's contents start with: the state at `Do`, after the
34    /// form's `/Matrix`, with the group's own opacity, soft mask and blend mode already taken
35    /// by the layer the group is composited through.
36    state: State<'a>,
37    root_transform: Affine,
38    bbox: Rect,
39    interpreter_cache: InterpreterCache<'a>,
40    settings: InterpreterSettings,
41    xref: &'a XRef,
42    nesting_depth: u32,
43}
44
45impl<'a, 'b> CmykGroup<'a, 'b> {
46    pub(crate) fn new(form: &'b FormXObject<'a>, resources: &'b Resources<'a>, context: &Context<'a>) -> Self {
47        let mut state = context.get().clone();
48        // The clips in force belong to the device the group is composited onto; contents
49        // interpreted on their own push and pop only the clips they set themselves.
50        state.clips = Vec::<ClipType>::new();
51        Self {
52            form,
53            resources,
54            state,
55            root_transform: context.root_transform(),
56            bbox: context.bbox(),
57            interpreter_cache: context.interpreter_cache.clone(),
58            settings: context.settings.clone(),
59            xref: context.xref,
60            nesting_depth: context.nesting_depth(),
61        }
62    }
63
64    /// The device-space box the group can paint: its `/BBox` under the current transform,
65    /// within the area being drawn.
66    pub fn device_bbox(&self) -> Rect {
67        let [x0, y0, x1, y1] = self.form.bbox;
68        let user = Rect::new(x0 as f64, y0 as f64, x1 as f64, y1 as f64);
69        let device = (self.state.ctm * user.to_path(0.1)).bounding_box();
70        device.intersect(self.bbox)
71    }
72
73    /// Interpret the group's contents into `device`, with device space moved by `offset`
74    /// (so a device covering only [`Self::device_bbox`] can start at its corner).
75    pub fn interpret(&self, device: &mut impl Device<'a>, offset: (f64, f64)) {
76        let shift = Affine::translate((-offset.0, -offset.1));
77        let mut state = self.state.clone();
78        state.ctm = shift * state.ctm;
79        let mut context = Context::new_with(
80            shift * self.root_transform,
81            shift.transform_rect_bbox(self.bbox),
82            &self.interpreter_cache,
83            self.xref,
84            self.settings.clone(),
85            state,
86            self.nesting_depth,
87        );
88        interpret_form_contents(self.resources, self.form, &mut context, device);
89    }
90}
91
92/// Whether `form`'s transparency group blends in `DeviceCMYK`: it says so in its `/CS`.
93pub(crate) fn blends_in_device_cmyk(form: &Dict<'_>) -> bool {
94    form.get::<Dict<'_>>(GROUP).and_then(|g| g.get::<Name<'_>>(CS)).is_some_and(|cs| matches!(cs.deref(), b"DeviceCMYK" | b"CMYK"))
95}
96
97/// Whether `form`'s transparency group names a blending colour space of its own (`/CS`).
98pub(crate) fn names_a_blending_space(form: &Dict<'_>) -> bool {
99    form.get::<Dict<'_>>(GROUP).is_some_and(|g| g.contains_key(CS))
100}
